content.text: Avast is one of the most downloaded security brands in the world, and that is exactly why fake download sites copy its name. This guide shows how to download and install Avast safely on every device, how to activate a paid code, and what to do when the installation does not work.
First rule: download only from official places

Get Avast only from avast.com, the Microsoft Store, the Mac App Store, Google Play or the Apple App Store. Avoid "cracked", "full version" or torrent downloads and sites like get-into-PC copies: they are a common way to spread the very malware you want to stop, and a cracked security app cannot protect you.

items: 1. Go to avast.com and choose the product you want, for example Avast Free Antivirus or the Avast VPN.
2. The download is a small installer, such as avast_free_antivirus_setup_online.exe. Open it from your Downloads folder.
3. Click Yes when Windows asks for permission, then Install. The installer picks the right 32-bit, 64-bit or ARM64 version by itself.
4. Wait a few minutes, then open Avast and run the first Smart Scan.
Note: Windows in S mode only runs apps from the Microsoft Store, so switch out of S mode first or use the Store version.

content.text: Avast still supports Windows 8 and 8.1, and Windows 7 with Service Pack 1 (32-bit and 64-bit). Install Windows updates first, especially Service Pack 1 on Windows 7, then use the same installer from avast.com. Because Microsoft no longer updates Windows 7, a good antivirus and a VPN matter even more on these PCs.

Download Avast Security or the Avast VPN for Mac from avast.com or the Mac App Store, open the .dmg file and follow the installer. macOS will ask you to allow a system extension or VPN configuration: open System Settings > Privacy & Security and click Allow. Avast supports the current and two previous versions of macOS, including Macs with Apple M chips.

Open Google Play, search for Avast and install the app published by Avast Software, such as Avast Antivirus & Security or the Avast VPN app. You need Android 10 or later and the Google Play app. On first start, allow the permissions it asks for so it can scan apps and Wi‑Fi.

Open the App Store, search for Avast and install the app by Avast Software. When you first turn on the VPN, iOS asks to add a VPN configuration: tap Allow and confirm with Face ID, Touch ID or your passcode. Avast supports the current and two previous versions of iOS and iPadOS.
How to activate a paid Avast code

Open the app, go to the menu and choose "Enter activation code" (on Windows: Menu > My subscriptions > Enter a valid activation code). Paste the code including the dashes. Your subscription then shows as Active with its end date.

items: Another antivirus is installed: uninstall it first, two antivirus programs fight each other.
The installer stops or fails: restart the PC, check your internet connection and run the installer again as administrator.
Old Avast left behind: use Avast's official uninstall tool (Avast Clear) from avast.com, restart and install again.
Not enough space: free at least 2 GB on your system drive.
The VPN does not connect: switch the protocol in Advanced settings or try another server location.
